notice.title: Heads up: this iOS version is older than the app is tuned for
notice.body:
MODDYS World Radio installs on {hard} or newer, and is tuned for {soft} or newer.

This device reports {system}. The app will run, and this notice is the whole warning - expect rough edges.

Playback happens in {engine}, which is part of iOS itself, so on a release this old it cannot be updated without updating the system. That engine decides which streams can decode and whether playback can start without a tap.

Tap "What can this device play?" to see that answer for this exact device: the Check panel lists the engine version, the formats it can decode, and how many of the 47,994 stations it can actually play.

unsupported.title: MODDYS World Radio does not support this iOS version
unsupported.body:
The app needs {hard} or newer; this device reports {system}.

Why: {hard} is the oldest iOS that Apple's current build tools will target, and the oldest whose WebKit this app is built and tested against.

Use moddys.net in Safari on this device instead - the whole station list works in the browser. On a newer device, install the app.
